name: Xiàng Shí Fù
description: Xiàng Shí Fù ('Watching Ten Sets') is a Chinese solitaire domino game adapted for cards. Uses Chinese dominoes or equivalent card representations. Objective: arrange 32 tiles/cards into 10 valid triplets + 1 valid pair. Also known as Cān Chán ('Zen').
deck: Chinese domino set (32 tiles) or card equivalent

overview.description: Xiàng Shí Fù ('Watching Ten Sets') is a Chinese solitaire domino game adapted for cards. Uses Chinese dominoes or equivalent card representations. Objective: arrange 32 tiles/cards into 10 valid triplets + 1 valid pair. Also known as Cān Chán ('Zen').
overview.deck: Chinese domino set (32 tiles) or card equivalent

history.origins: Xiàng Shí Fù is a traditional Chinese domino solitaire. The name means 'Watching Ten Sets'; it is also known as Cān Chán (參禪), meaning Zen. Play uses a standard 32-tile Chinese domino set; the aim is to rearrange the tiles into 10 valid triplets and one valid pair. English-language rules draw on contributions from Dmytro Polovinkin and Min Fanxin (闵凡信).
timeline: Traditional Chinese domino solitaire; rules published in English in the 2020s.

setup.deck: 32 Chinese domino tiles or card equivalents.

rules.objective: Rearrange the 32 tiles into 10 valid triplets and one valid pair; all sets must be valid under Chinese domino pairing and triplet rules.
rules.gameplay: Form valid groupings according to Chinese domino pairing rules. Each triplet must contain valid combinations. One pair remains.

scoring.description: No points; win when all 10 triplets and 1 pair are valid under Chinese domino rules.
scoring.winCondition: All 11 sets valid: 10 valid triplets and 1 valid pair.

synthesis.shortDescription: Chinese domino solitaire: arrange 32 tiles into 10 valid triplets and 1 valid pair by exchanging tiles between sets so both stay valid.
